scope: Independent source identity, reconstruction, historical evidence consistency, scope, package hygiene, and informational origin/notice review of original intrinsic audit PR3 rows 24/26 and PR5 row 30. This report is not legal clearance, a license grant, production qualification, or publication authorization.

checks.detail: All thirteen non-review payload files match FILES.json byte counts and SHA-256 values and SHA256SUMS. The previous review also matched its recorded hash before replacement. Original source/patch/script identities remain unchanged. Final manifests must be refreshed for this replacement report.

DecimalResiduals.java, RegexCorrectness.java, PublicCallerProbe.java, regex.original.patch, and make_regex_overlay.original.py are byte-for-byte equal to their retained originals and match the original text-results.json artifact hashes.

DecimalResiduals.java is the original untimed standalone bounded 9/18-digit ASCII parse model with public-parser fallback, plus byte[] put8 emission. Its retained 300,036 checks comprise 36 parse edge cases and 100,000 iterations of int parse, long parse, and eight-digit byte emission checks. It is not a production patch, complete formatter, UTF16/char[] emitter, native PR3 implementation, or performance result.

The recovered overlay adds String-only Pattern.Slice regionMatches and Pattern.BnM indexOf paths against the retained f360 baseline. Custom/mutable CharSequence paths remain separate. It is not native PR5 integration. The copied PublicCallerProbe has seven regex cases among 41 total and is explicitly not a PR5-only runner. Unrelated TextProbe models are not staged or represented as PR3/PR5 evidence.

Independent in-memory application of all three original diff hunks to the retained baseline reproduces the retained candidate exactly. The normalized patch has identical hunks and only normalized diff headers/paths with historical timestamps removed. No source generator, JVM, or build was run.

Compact decimal and regex outcome text and log hashes exactly match the retained original logs. The regex baseline/prototype logs both record 83,268 outcomes and the same digest. These are verified historical records, not rerun correctness checks.

All 41 case statistics in the retained public-summary.json were independently recalculated from all 24 retained raw process outputs and match exactly, including medians, paired ratios, nominal bootstrap intervals, order splits, allocations, wins, and raw ratios. The seven staged regex summaries match exactly. All original recorded exits are zero, stderr files are empty, and ordering is six AB plus six BA pairs. No timing was rerun.

Historical f360107d541ff20d06bff4816a717e9805718fff source-overlay baseline and older 8d030adbd245b19e6339e3ccd052eb7fe3635319 runtime labels remain distinct. PublicCallerProbe source bytes match recorded harness SHA-256 92eb060a17661a15b11fd06b53abb5de9711ab72545b4f99af8fcc729df180f6. This is source identity evidence, not independent proof of historical class-file identity or a current whole-JDK/native PR5 result.

The package retains noisy small-case/order uncertainty, custom-CharSequence control status, short-screen limits, unreconciled native PR5 integration, and the measured +128 B/op compile+match32 allocation cost. It makes no decimal timing or automatic adoption claim.

Both patches preserve the original Pattern copyright/license header. The new Pattern-NOTICE.txt contains that complete unchanged header and explicitly covers both patches and embedded Pattern fragments in make_regex_overlay.original.py. Included LICENSE bytes retain Git blob identity 8b400c7ab81b7b18baff3f81d597f5e511883134. SOURCE_ORIGIN.json distinguishes three audit-specific drivers from upstream-derived patch/script material and asserts no copyright owner, new license, authorship, relicensing right, or legal clearance. No historical model Git commit is invented.

All payload files are small UTF-8 text, without NUL bytes or symlinks. The largest is 19,274 bytes. No class files, archives, runtime images, large raw logs, hard-coded local runtime launcher, or credential-like strings were found by manual review and bounded common secret-pattern checks. This is not a guarantee that every possible secret form is detectable.

SOURCE_ORIGIN.json source-manifest hash, three driver hashes, exact script-to-Pattern source ranges, bounded source-comparison results, and explicit limits match independent inspection. Missing per-file headers alone are not treated as a demonstrated source-provenance defect. The sidecars document provenance; they do not grant distribution rights or determine ownership.

sourceOriginFindings.decimalDistinction: The model uses four-digit positive accumulation and four division/remainder byte pairs. Retained PR3 Integer.java:483 onward and Long.java:516 onward use general-radix negative accumulation and range checks; ToDecimal.java:102-119 uses an eight-step y recurrence and distinct Latin1/UTF16 stores. The model is not a verbatim copy of those retained implementations.
sourceOriginFindings.additionalAdaptedPatternLogic: Replacement blocks retain/adapt existing Slice short-input state at baseline 4265-4268 and BnM first/groups/last and end-state logic at 5734-5740 and 5747-5748. This reinforces treating the reconstruction script as upstream-derived material alongside the patches.
